comment: The leading space dismisses startup, and the count of 4 leaves gm.multi at 3 when cmd.c rhack() dispatches the inventory command. ddoinv() answers ECMD_OK, so rhack()'s result tail calls reset_cmd_vars(), which zeroes gm.multi: allmain.c moveloop_core() finds no count left and the inventory is shown once. Escape closes the menu and the look command that follows runs at once, where a repeated inventory would have opened a second menu. This recipe was once kept as blocked on the belief that C repeats the inventory; the recording shows that C does not.
